scope: Read-only frozen source and existing sample files. No live VM/Disk read, mount, process sampling/query, test/benchmark, build or production change. Existing root-maintained performance-analysis untouched.
assumptions: One successful public vm rollback-kernel --to-transaction invocation; no --preview/--list/recover or failure/retry.
Current desired ready, normal targetA committed schema3 with planBinding schema2, same generation/catalog and original set, production default adapters.
Separate previous public list/preview commands are excluded; counts are source call executions, not measured hardware I/O or wall time.

Store_expansion: Session.init62 hashes CLI once; withVerifiedSource37 session.recheck invokes verifiedReceipt and CLI hash once.
KernelUpdate.recheck78->Session.recheck adds verifiedReceipt and CLI hash once.

Each verifiedReceipt includes secureTree/layout/receipt, verifyBundle and two cdhash calls. Each cdhash verifies its executable, yielding three explicit signature-validity API invocations per verifiedReceipt. Internal OS nested/resource work is not counted as exact I/O.

first_journal_boundary.note: VM lifetime lock may already write .vphone-runtime.json before the firmware transaction mkdir; this count boundary does not imply no filesystem writes of any kind.

sample.interpretation: This is the second recheck inside transaction.withWorkerLock, after constructor mkdir/saveJournal; not the first pre-transaction recheck78.

root_reported_phase_correction.original_observer: 77544 ran without sudo and Path.exists reported inaccessible root0700 transaction as absent; its stage observation is not authoritative.
root_reported_phase_correction.replacement: Root observer asserts root and distinguishes FileNotFoundError from other stat errors. Reviewer did not read live journal.

worker_second_recheck_excluded_from_pre_.meaning: By this successful callsite there have been49 loadVerified calls plus one separate entries digest set; Disk SHA here is third overall. These are static prefix counts, not a measured execution counter.

loops_and_waits: No prepare->publish retry loop, recursive public operation or sleep is visible on this success path.

loadVerified traverses each manifest original, recursively scans directory members and streams1MiB reads until EOF. Transaction entries digest adds another recursive/EOF scan. History iterates effects and plan owners.
Store secureTree recursively checks entries; signature APIs and synchronous regular-file reads may take time. This source review does not measure their internal waits.
Store/VM/worker flock acquisitions use LOCK_NB and throw on busy; there is no source-level lock retry/sleep in this path.
checkMounts synchronously executes hdiutil info; its pipe reads and waitUntilExit have no explicit timeout here. The1s sample does not show this wait, and cannot exclude waits elsewhere.
Hash loops are EOF-driven rather than an operation retry. External I/O or unexpected ongoing file mutation can affect duration; no interval timings are available.
limits: 635 samples describe only the saved short window. They cannot establish the whole15minute time split, average utilization, cause of all slowness, remaining work or ETA.
39 generation rounds and128GiB logical Disk SHA are source counts; page cache, sparse storage, APFS behavior and OS internals prevent equating them to physical SSD reads or seconds.
No caching/qualification optimization is implemented. Existing Store->VM->worker and full content/CAS checks remain unchanged.
The actual sample filename contains pretransaction for historical reasons; its classification is transaction-internal recheck86.
